prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "sluta". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "quit".
Scene: An adult man putting an unopened cigarette packet into a bin, a clear crossed-out cigarette symbol above it, calm determined expression, no smoking or product branding.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "sluta = quit or stop doing something.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han vill sluta röka.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
